title: Stars of Akarios
subtitle: A narrative-driven tactical space crawler with deep starfighter dogfights and planetary exploration
tagline: Chart uncharted stars, command the Sparrow, and defend the remnants of civilization
loreSummary: When an overwhelming hostile assault leaves your home planet in ruins, cadet pilots must rally aboard the starship Sparrow to forge an intrepid path through unknown systems in search of answers and survival.
keyFeatures: Tactical ship-to-ship dogfights using dice-allocation maneuvers and modifier decks
Dual-mode gameplay alternating space combat with on-foot planetary exploration
Shared starship management and progressive tech upgrades aboard the Sparrow
Dynamic choose-your-own-adventure story branching across three sweeping narrative acts

akarios_standard.name: Standard Galactic Odyssey
akarios_standard.description: The recommended campaign run balancing primary missions, pivotal system discoveries, pilot upgrades, and key side scenarios.

akarios_story.name: Cadet Flight Path (Main Story Focus)
akarios_story.description: A focused narrative route prioritizing the central storyline missions directly toward the campaign finale with minimal optional detours.

akarios_completionist.name: Master Navigator (Complete Galaxy Charting)
akarios_completionist.description: Exhaustive exploration across all reachable stellar sectors, tackling every available side scenario, world mission, and maximum starship upgrade.
